objective: Admit bounded long-horizon subtasks and repair proposals only when they remain bound to immutable global intent, required constraints, checkpoint lineage, trace position, verifier evidence, generation, freshness, and repair budgets.

research_inputs.finding: OneDayAgent treats long-horizon work as a managed process with bounded task decomposition, execution memory under context pressure, global verification, and targeted repair across cross-environment and multimodal tasks.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: FAISAL adds intent-bound subtask and repair receipts without embedding a model, executing tools, or modifying artifacts.

research_inputs.finding: Vision-language-action systems face irreversible consequences, multimodal attack surfaces, real-time safety constraints, compounding trajectory errors, and supply-chain risks; deployment requires runtime monitoring, traceability, human oversight, and standardized evaluation.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: The contract fences subtasks and repairs to explicit intent, constraints, checkpoints, trace positions, verifier digests, and bounded repair counts while keeping receipts non-authoritative.

features: bounded subtask count and monotonic trace positions
verifier digest and failed-constraint repair binding
bounded repair index and repair budget
generation, expiry, replay, stale, and authority-boundary fences
receipt-only output with execution_performed=false and artifact_modified=false

benchmark.scope: local Python control-plane admission overhead; excludes model planning, tool execution, artifact mutation, verifier execution, external services, and production approval latency

limitations: The contract validates caller-supplied intent, constraints, checkpoints, trace positions, artifacts, and verifier digests; it does not independently inspect task state or deliverables.
The contract admits repair proposals but does not perform repair, verify artifacts, or execute tools.
The benchmark does not establish long-horizon task success, multimodal capability, robotics safety, AGI capability, production efficacy, or Linux superiority.
No physical hardware, external reviewer, independent builder, live multihost environment, or production approval was exercised.

rollback.rollback_scope: remove the intent-repair module, tests, benchmark, runner, evidence registration, and metadata; retain the tool-attestation release tag
